changes_v2: ops-v2 (SPEC_DATA_v3): `message` field required in every model object (natural text in the admin's language; summary_ar only required for executable actions/plans); control action `reply`; read-only INFO actions card_batch_status / list_card_batches / subscriber_info / online_sessions answered by a RESULT (or CHOICES) tool message; choice source list_card_batches; change_plan_policies items {n,id,label_ar}; CONTEXT permission vocabulary adds cards.view, cards.generate_direct, online.view. INFO endpoints cite the executor branch (source_v2).
changes_v3: ops-v3 (SPEC_DATA_v4_DRAFT): additive. (1) Smart search: when an exact/substring lookup (find_subscriber, list_plans, list_offers, list_card_batches) finds nothing, the executor answers CHOICES with "match":"fuzzy" + "query" and at most 5 similar records (digits: <=2 edits after +970/972/0 normalisation; names: Arabic folding + similarity + Latin<->Arabic skeleton). Suggestions are NEVER issued: the model asks «هل تقصد…؟» (ask, missing=["choice"]) and never acts on them; the admin's pick (click or text) resolves the record exactly. A card number typed exactly in list_card_batches resolves its batch ("match":"card"); card numbers are never suggested fuzzily. A phone written differently (+970 / spaces / Arabic digits) is an exact match (no "match" key). (2) New read-only INFO actions recent_subscribers {limit?, mine?}, recent_card_batches {limit?, mine?}, recent_activity {limit?} — default 5, max 20 — answered with RESULT; their usernames / batch ids are issued.
level: 1 = draft only. The model converses, collects fields and emits ONE JSON proposal + an Arabic summary. Deterministic executor code validates the proposal against this catalog, re-reads the live record, shows the admin a confirmation card, and only then calls the HobeRadius API with the logged-in admin's own token. The model never executes anything.

conventions.auth_and_rbac: The executor MUST call with a token bound to the logged-in admin (g.admin_id > 0). An UNBOUND token (env HOBERADIUS_API_TOKENS / token without created_by) bypasses RBAC entirely (app/api/access_control.py:127-132, app/api/permission_guard.py:12-20) — never use one for the assistant. Every v1 endpoint is mapped to the SAME decision as its web endpoint (app/api/permission_guard.py:135+, deny-by-default).
conventions.tenant_scope: tenant_id comes from the token (g.tenant_id, app/api/auth.py:30). Every service query is WHERE tenant_id=?. The model never sends tenant_id.
conventions.distributor_scope: Non-full-access managers only see/act on their own subscribers ∪ their distributors' (subscriber_in_scope, app/api/access_control.py:225-245); out of scope → 403 deny_out_of_scope. find_subscriber already returns only in-scope rows.
conventions.ids_rule: Every *_id / username that identifies an existing record MUST be copied from a CHOICES list or a RESULT the executor returned in THIS conversation (list_plans, list_offers, find_subscriber, list_card_batches, change_plan_policies, event rows, INFO RESULT rows, execution RESULT). The executor rejects any id not present in the issued set for this conversation (never invented, never typed by the user and passed through unverified).
conventions.message_rule: Every model object carries `message` (top level, non-empty, <= 400 chars): the natural text shown to the admin, in the admin's language/dialect (MSA, Palestinian colloquial, English; arabizi -> colloquial Arabic script). Numbers/names only from the admin's text, CHOICES or RESULT, copied exactly; never claims an execution without RESULT source=execution; never a secret. The executor never uses message/summary_ar for decisions (SPEC_DATA_v3 §1-§2).
conventions.time: API datetimes are UTC ISO-8601 with Z. The owner's display zone is Asia/Gaza (DST). The model only emits LOCAL wall-clock strings (field names *_local, format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM) or durations; the executor converts local→UTC.
conventions.owner_extend_cap: One operation may add at most limits.max_extend_days (default 365 = one year) — app/radius/core/numbers.py:240-246, app/radius/core/limits.py:44,166-171. Repetition is allowed. Executor enforces min(365 days, server value) BEFORE calling.

units.month_rule: OPEN QUESTION Q1. The API has no month unit (extend takes minutes; app offers days/hours/minutes only: rma subscriber_actions_model.dart:430-434). Proposed: months → calendar months in Asia/Gaza via mode=expire_at (exact end date), else 30 days (the codebase's plan-period fallback = 43200 min, users.py plan_period_minutes:1381-1385). 12 months must still pass the 365-day cap (calendar 12 months = 365/366 days → a leap span fails).
units.speed: kbps everywhere in the API. 1 Mbps = 1024 kbps, 1 Gbps = 1024*1024 (app/radius/core/units.py:24-26).
units.money: Decimal in the system currency (default shekel). The model only proposes amounts the admin stated explicitly; never computes prices.

conventions.idempotency: Executor sends header Idempotency-Key: <uuid per confirmed proposal> on every write. Honoured (24h replay, fingerprint-bound) on /accounts/<u>/extend and /change-plan (app/api/v1/subscriber_actions.py:36-37,82-85; app/api/v1/idempotency.py:1-18) and on /cards/generate (app/api/v1/cards.py:605-620). Other writes are not idempotent → executor must not auto-retry them.

control_actions.ask: Required fields missing or ambiguous. fields = what is known so far; missing = field names still needed; summary_ar = the question to the admin.
control_actions.choose: A record must be picked from the system. fields.source = one of the choice_sources names, fields.query = optional search text; executor returns a numbered list; the model then refers to the picked item's id.
control_actions.refuse: Out of scope, unsafe (e.g. the admin dictates a password/secret), or an action not in this catalog. summary_ar explains briefly.
control_actions.cancel: The admin abandoned the current draft.
control_actions.reply: Nothing to execute: greetings, thanks, help / what-can-you-do, how/why questions, answers built from RESULT or from a plain lookup's CHOICES, empty results. fields = {}, missing = [], message = the answer. Never needs confirmation. refuse = asked to DO something not allowed; reply = nothing to do (SPEC_DATA_v3 §3).

forbidden_model_fields.rule: These keys must NEVER appear in fields (executor rejects the whole proposal; ops/score.py safe_ok also flags pass/secret/token/pin/api_key).

why.password/pppoe_password: secrets never pass through the model; executor generates or the admin types it in the UI.
why.balance: money; direct balance write is owner-only (manager → 403) app/api/v1/accounts.py:541-549,387-405; use the money actions in the UI.
why.status: only through suspend_subscriber / enable_subscriber endpoints (side effects differ).
why.expire_at: the executor computes it from duration/until_local after converting the timezone.
why.temporary_speed/custom_speed: raw flags in /accounts PATCH whitelist (accounts.py:84-85) write a flag WITHOUT a window/CoA — always use temporary_speed action.

executor_checklist: 1. JSON-Schema validate the proposal (output_schema). Reject unknown keys and any forbidden_model_fields key anywhere (deep scan).
2. Every *_id / username must be in the choice set issued in this session; re-read the record live (GET) right before the confirm card.
3. Normalize: Arabic-Indic digits → Latin; local times (Asia/Gaza) → UTC; duration → minutes; enforce the 1-year cap and the per-action ranges here, before the API.
4. Pre-check permission with GET /accounts/<u>/actions-context .permissions (subscriber actions) — hide/deny early instead of letting the API 403.
5. Show the Arabic confirmation card built by the EXECUTOR from validated values (not summary_ar verbatim) + danger level; require an explicit click for L2/L3.
6. Call with the admin's bound token + Idempotency-Key; never auto-retry non-idempotent writes.
7. Return to the model only a redacted result (no passwords, no card codes, no balance when hidden).

8. INFO actions (card_batch_status, subscriber_info, online_sessions): schema, issued ids, permission, then GET through the real /api/v1 handler with the admin's credential, whitelist, RESULT {"source":<action>,"data":{...}} (or {"error":code}); ids in RESULT are issued. No confirmation (L1).
9. Empty CHOICES: the UI shows an empty-state line, not an empty card; the same choose source+query that already returned [] in this conversation is answered by the executor (no second lookup).

open_questions.Q1: Month unit: calendar months (Asia/Gaza, via expire_at) or 30 days? 12 calendar months across a leap Feb = 366 days > 365 cap.
open_questions.Q2: Card offers have no /api/v1 endpoints (list/create/use). Add GET /api/v1/cards/offers, POST /api/v1/cards/offers, POST /api/v1/cards/offers/<id>/generate (with the same wallet charge + price lock as routes/cards.py:3589+), or keep create_offer / offer batches as web hand-off in v1?
open_questions.Q3: suspend_subscriber = POST /disable (status 'disabled' + PoD). Should 'suspended' (PATCH status, users.edit, no immediate reconcile path) ever be used?
open_questions.Q4: temporary_speed for an OFFLINE subscriber is web-only (profile form). Need an API endpoint, or only online in v1?
open_questions.Q5: create_subscriber with a duration: set expire_at directly at creation (no ledger/payment), or create born-expired then a paid renew_or_extend (ledger + manager spend gate)? Which is the owner's intended accounting?
open_questions.Q6: Password delivery for create_subscriber: executor-generated (shown once to the admin / sent via send-credentials) or admin types it in a masked field?
open_questions.Q7: Managers who may only generate FROM OFFERS (no full_batch_form grant) cannot use /cards/generate (403). Until Q2 is solved, create_card_batch works only for owner / fully-granted managers.
